title: Tor amplitude descends along a faithfully flat ring map
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the property of a complex having tor amplitude concentrated in a bounded interval can be tested after a faithfully flat base change (statement lines 17237-17242). The proof is a 15-line computation with the derived tensor product (proof lines 17245-17259): one uses flatness of R to R' to identify the derived tensor product of M with K after base change as the base change of M tensor over R' with K tensor R', then observes that taking cohomology commutes with the exact functor tensor R', so that each Tor group after base change is the base change of the corresponding Tor group over R, and finally invokes faithful flatness to read off vanishing over R from vanishing over R'. Each of the three steps is a distinct use of one hypothesis, and the identification of the two derived tensor products is the point where flatness, not faithful flatness, does the work.
